headline: Washington says goodbye to his officers
post_facts: A tearful farewell at Fraunces Tavern
He gave up command 19 days later
Then he went home to Mount Vernon

scenes.text: [softly] On this day, in seventeen eighty-three... George Washington said goodbye to his officers.

scenes.label: New York City
scenes.caption: Painting by Alonzo Chappel, 1866
scenes.title: A hand for every officer
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] At a New York tavern, he asked each officer to take his hand.

scenes.label: later, he gave up command of the army
scenes.text: [solemnly] Nineteen days later, he gave up command of the army.

scenes.label: Fraunces Tavern
scenes.caption: Lower Manhattan today
scenes.title: Now a museum
scenes.text: [calmly] That tavern, Fraunces Tavern, is a museum today.

scenes.title: He chose to go home
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He could have kept power... he went home instead.

scenes.title: Could you walk away from that much power?
scenes.text: [gently] Could you walk away from that much power?
